extraction_notes: Datasheet identity verified as B5817WS THRU B5819WS SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER, Rev:1.0, three pages; the supplied MPN B5818WS is the middle variant in the grouped datasheet. The requested manufacturer value is hongjiacheng; the datasheet footer names Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd.

Figures 1 through 4 were digitized from the supplied vector plots without synthesized or interpolated points. Figures 1 and 2 are grouped B5817WS through B5819WS typical curves; reverse current is represented as the positive magnitude shown on the logarithmic axis. Figure 3 is typical junction capacitance at Ta=25 degC and f=1 MHz. Figure 4 is power dissipation versus ambient temperature.
Electrical table semantics are preserved: VF1 and VF2 are maximums, IR1 is a maximum, and CJ is typical. SI conversions are used for mA to A, pF to F, and mW to W.

Absolute maximum ratings on p. 1 include VRRM=30 V, VRMS=21 V, VDC=30 V, IF(AV)=1.0 A, IFSM=10 A at t=8.3 ms half-sine wave, Pd=250 mW, Tj=-55 to +150 degC, Tstg=-55 to +150 degC, and RthetaJ-A=400 degC/W; these ratings are not treated as breakdown data.
The supplied datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time, breakdown-voltage, or breakdown-current specification. VRRM and VDC are absolute maximum ratings, not substituted for breakdown data.
